title: Advisory layer (SHOULD / RECOMMENDED)
description: Decision #48: SHOULD and RECOMMENDED clauses warn and never fail. Each $def is applied to a document already validated by its normative schema; any error here is reported as a warning.

excerpt.description: §5.9: publishers SHOULD cap the excerpt near 200 characters (240 allows 'near'). Decision #30.

prefix.description: §10.3: prefix OPTIONAL and short (decision #49). 64 is this checker's reading of 'short'.

item.description: §3.1: item documents carry the `blyg` key (no RFC keyword — warn); §5.8: page is optional for conformance but SHOULD be used by readers and is required of the reference client; §9 lists media = [] on endcaps, implying the key is always present.

items.description: §5.7 rule 1: model and at are RECOMMENDED.

content_md.description: §5.3: publishers SHOULD cap fragments at 2,000 characters (studio RECOMMENDED 1,000); readers MUST NOT reject.

pinned.description: §8 rule 6: a pinned file SHOULD carry the author assertion as published; §8 rule 4: pinned documents carry no media array.

manifest.description: §3.2: generator SHOULD be emitted as name/version; §6.1: generator_url SHOULD be emitted (decision #34).

feed.description: §4: file names within the surface are protocol-fixed at 0.3.
